summary: Confirmed water, store. Added $45 RV rate (2027), 50-amp electric, 32 sites, weekend 2-night minimum, wifi. Note cleaned and its '15 mi' replaced with the operator's 'less than 30 miles'.
flags: PRIVATE GATE FACTS: posted rate $45 (engine, July 2027), under $50. Good Sam not a GS Park (gsr.py: general 8.3, facility 7, restroom 9, appeal 9; a score under 8.5 drops nothing). Gateway not needed. Presence: own site and live ResNexus booking. Google: 'Shin Pond Village Campground' 4.8 on 179 reviews, phone (207) 528-2900; the separate resort listing 4.9 on 175. RV Life 4.5. I read no review text for this one.
SEASONAL: no seasonal offer on any operator page read; the RV sites book nightly. Not mostly seasonal on that evidence.

AMENITY CONFLICT: the operator's /camping icon row for tent sites says 'NO Wi-Fi', while the home page says 'We also have Wi-Fi' at the main building. Written wifi true on the home page; site-level Wi-Fi isn't claimed.

UNREAD: showers and dump aren't stated by the operator. A testimonial on its home page mentions a clean 'bath house'. Full site description on ResNexus is truncated and 'More Details' didn't open for me, so sewer stayed absent and I don't know a max rig length. Season also unstated ('Four Seasons Fun' is the snowmobile business, not a campsite season).

WATERFRONT 'not waterfront' stands. Only the three rental homes are on Lower Shin Pond; imagery shows the pond across the road SE of the campground. Operator's brook sites are tent sites. No RV site on either as far as I can see.
PIN: stored point sits at the main building, by the road. Fine: RV spurs visible immediately NE and a field loop W, all within ~250 m.
